title: Replace CuratedBlocksColumn with zoomable project tree

summary.goal: Replace the right column's CuratedBlocksColumn with a zoomable project tree showing work organized by scope.

acceptance_criteria.description: CuratedBlocksColumn removed from TendLayout right column
ProjectTree component renders steps grouped by scope (WorkSection per scope)
Three zoom levels work: OVERVIEW (scope headers with progress bars), SCOPE (one expanded with StepNode list), STEP (full step detail visible)
TreeBreadcrumb shows current zoom path and clicking segments zooms out
URL params sync with zoom state: ?zoom=overview|scope|step&focus=scope-id.step-id
StepNode (adapted from planner-ui StepEditor) shows compact view: title + status indicator (○ pending, ⟳ running, ✓ done)
ScopeHeader shows scope name + progress bar (done/total steps)
ArtifactsSection exists (empty initially, populated when forge reports artifacts)
ProjectContext (adapted from planner-ui PlanEditorContext) provides step data + real-time SSE sync
Clicking a step at OVERVIEW zoom → zooms to SCOPE. Clicking at SCOPE → zooms to STEP.

observations: The right column is the biggest structural change. CuratedBlocksColumn is a flat vertical list of curated blocks. Replacing with a hierarchical, zoomable tree.

Key components to copy from planner-ui: StepEditor (simplify to compact StepNode), SwimlaneView + useTopologicalSort (adapt from horizontal to vertical), DependencyIndicator (reuse as-is), PlanEditorContext (adapt to ProjectContext).
New: ProjectTree container, TreeBreadcrumb, WorkSection, ScopeHeader, ArtifactsSection.

steps.title: Remove CuratedBlocksColumn and create ProjectTree container
steps.description: Delete packages/tend/src/components/dashboard/CuratedBlocksColumn.tsx. Create packages/tend/src/components/tree/ProjectTree.tsx with zoom state management (OVERVIEW/SCOPE/STEP). Add URL param sync: ?zoom=overview|scope|step&focus=scope-id.step-id.

steps.title: Copy and adapt StepEditor from planner-ui to StepNode
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/components/steps/StepEditor.tsx → packages/tend/src/components/tree/StepNode.tsx. Simplify to compact view: title + status indicator only (○ pending, ⟳ running, ✓ done). Remove inline editing (editing moves to sheets later).

steps.title: Create WorkSection and ScopeHeader components
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/tree/WorkSection.tsx — groups StepNode list by scope. Create packages/tend/src/components/tree/ScopeHeader.tsx — renders scope name + progress bar (done/total steps). Copy progress calculation logic from planner-ui StepList.

steps.title: Create TreeBreadcrumb with URL param sync
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/tree/TreeBreadcrumb.tsx. Render zoom path as clickable segments (Project > Scope > Step). Wire to URL params. Clicking segments zooms out. Reference planner-ui breadcrumb patterns if any exist.

steps.title: Create ArtifactsSection shell
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/tree/ArtifactsSection.tsx — empty component, renders 'No artifacts yet'. Will be populated later by forge integration. Hidden when empty.

steps.title: Adapt PlanEditorContext to ProjectContext
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/contexts/PlanEditorContext.tsx → packages/tend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx. Adapt for project-scoped data (steps + blocks + project config). Wire SSE sync using existing usePlanEvents pattern. Provide step data to tree components.

steps.title: Wire zoom interaction click handlers
steps.description: In StepNode: add onClick handler. At OVERVIEW zoom → click ScopeHeader → set zoom to SCOPE, focus to scope-id. At SCOPE zoom → click StepNode → set zoom to STEP, focus to step-id. Update URL params on each transition.

components_to_copy: planner-ui SwimlaneView → adapt from horizontal to vertical
